svg.title: Test runs: a pass through the test cases, with results and the bugs they raised — SoftTrack web design mockup (#275)
svg.desc: Test cases say how to test, and nothing says that it was done. A run is a selection of cases for a release, a sprint or an epic; each case gets a result with a note; a failure raises a bug that arrives filled in; and the release and the stories show the latest results.
svg.text: Test runs: a pass through the test cases, with results and the bugs they raised
· that it was tested, and what happened

g.text: the run for release 1.4.0, signed in as Ravi
For release 1.4.0 · staging · owned by Ravi Patel · 14 cases from Sign-in and Invoices
An invoice opens from the list
An invoice downloads as a PDF
Step 3: a PDF with one blank page, on Safari 17.
Step 4: the link signed in a second time.
A zip holds every invoice chosen

svg.text: Raising a bug from a failure

g.text: For release 1.4.0 · staging · owned by Ravi Patel · 14 cases from Sign-in and Invoices
1. Ask for a sign-in link. 2. Open it. 3. Sign out. 4. Open it
with the version each run executed
TC-22 · EVERY RUN IT HAS BEEN IN

svg.text: Done when a run selects cases for a release, a sprint or an epic and assigns them to people, each case gets a result of passed, failed, blocked or skipped with a note and
attachments, a failure can raise a bug filled in from the case, progress shows what passed, failed and remains, a closed run’s results are fixed, and a release’s page and a story

g.text: That it was tested, by whom,
Until now that was known to the
A failure that already has its bug links
One that has none offers to raise it.
The run informs the decision to release. It does not make it: there
A closed run’s results are fixed. Testing again is a new run.
